card.name: Warming to room temperature after refrigeration
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside a phrase about something coming to room temperature, such as allow, equilibrate, acclimate, or cool. It is strongest after refrigerated storage or temperature change.

modes.label: Allow to warm
modes.description: The verb allow or to after a refrigeration instruction, before 'to reach room temperature'.
modes.example: If refrigerated,<< allow>> the diluted TROGARZO solution

modes.label: Equilibrate/acclimate
modes.description: Inside verbs meaning to reach room temperature.
modes.example: allow the product to equ<<ilib>>rate to room temperature before patient use.

modes.label: Temperature change
modes.description: Words describing things cooling or changing temperature in general text.
modes.example: and as the jars<< cool>>, air pressure seals the lids tightly.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words describing a temperature change, such as reach, rate, or rapid.
card.plain: It fires on wording that says to let a refrigerated product come up to room temperature.
